construction: B-only first spectral response using signed paired baby/giant blocks, plus a signed baby-coordinate algebra and unit-pivot jet determinant contract
layout: b=max(1,floor(sqrt(r))/2),m=2b+1,n=ceil(r/m). Giant centers c_i=b+i*m; valid j in[-b,b] with0<=c_i+j<r. Each index0..r-1 occurs once; last block is clipped, never silently wrapped or dropped.
point_builder: For generator T, store babies0..b and n giant centers; step m*T=2*(b*T)+T. Build uses b+n addition calls, counting identity/doubling calls. Source generator is reusable across changing targets. No full r-point table in candidate.
paired_jet: For x(A +/- T)=H_A minus/plus K_A and x(B +/- V)=H_B minus/plus K_B, the pair factor plus uniform s has constant(H_A-H_B)^2-(K_A-K_B)^2 and linear2*(H_A-H_B); s^2=0. Keep relative sign.
baby_algebra: H(Z)=product_j=1..b(Z-x(jG)); interpolate beta=x(jQ),gamma=y(jG)*y(jQ) in K[Z]/H. Derive paired numerator polynomial and norm/determinant, with nonzero addition denominators; preserve gamma under joint sign and negate it under Q sign. No imported quasi-square-root resultant cost.
small_panels: Same Round60 F11/r7,F17/r19,F211/r199 models,G and shifts. r7/r19: all Q labels2..r-2 and all U labels0..r-1; r199: Q2,3,5,7,11,17,197 and U0,1,2,3,5,17,198. Total381 decoder cases, each7 shifted queries plus one reusable calibration per target.
candidate: Streaming paired (A,B) with no C. Calibrated seven-shift decoder from Round62. Candidate accepts public points, never scalar labels. Native cubic roots enumerate full small quadratic field and are counted separately.
references: Complete graph streaming/prefix-suffix B; signed baby-algebra norm for every full paired block using pivoted dual-number determinant with constant-unit pivots, permitting a final zero constant pivot. Original and references must have identical scientific outputs, with distinct count receipts.
metrics: Exact constructor addition calls/stored point slots; query addition calls, quadratic-field multiplications/inversions, paired/single factors, determinant pivots and input-generator coverage; all reference, decoder and setup work separate. No timing/statistical or speedup claim.
negative: Wrong relative-sign pair and altered retained coefficient must reject; scalar-reference recovery only after candidate outputs. Denominator, coverage and final partial block guards tested on every panel. No zero pivot inverted.
P192: Actual public Q,mu_G,relation_lambda_G from Round57 and quadratic shift6S from Round54. Selected indices0..26 with b4,m9,n3 and U=j(G-Q), j0,1,4,8,9,13,17,26.24 blocks compare full-width paired first coefficients with explicit27-factor contraction. Containment is planted by public group arithmetic; no arbitrary-target recovery or complete P192 norm. Also compute full-r layout integers without allocation.

bounds.retries: no search retry; preserve failures; source corrections published before affected checks

controls.AA: not applicable: exact algebra/counts without clocks or statistical inference
controls.positive: all declared supported decoder cases and planted P192 zero factors

sources: Round60 paired norm formula, Round62 calibrated B decoder; BFLS arxiv2003.10118 Lemma4.3/4.9, Example4.13 and section4.16 read. KB tools and wrapper unavailable; no novelty/absence claim for baby/giant, jets or determinant norms.
